newsitem.title: USA: Dura Pharm sets public offering of notes.
newsitem.headline: Dura Pharm sets public offering of notes.

text.p: Dura Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday it will offer $250 million principal amount of convertible subordinated notes due 2002 in a public offering.
The notes are convertible into Dura common stock at a price of $50.635 per share and bear interest at an annual rate of 3.5 percent.
The company may redeem the notes beginning July 15, 2000.
Merrill Lynch & Co and Goldman, Sachs & Co are the underwriters for the offering.
The company said has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to an additional $37.5 million principal amount of notes.
